description: Demonstrates call transfer to a live human agent. When the customer requests to speak with a human, the call is transferred to the configured phone number.

task_messages.content: Greet the customer: "Hi {customer_name}! This is regarding your order #{order_id}. I'm calling to confirm the details with you. Is now a good time to talk?"

role_messages.content: You are a friendly customer service representative. If the customer asks to speak with a human agent, use the transfer function to connect them to a live agent.

functions.description: Call when user confirms it's a good time to talk
Call when user doesn't want to continue or asks to call back later
Call when customer wants to speak to a human agent

task_messages.content: Confirm the order: "Thank you, {customer_name}! Your order is confirmed. Have a great day!"

role_messages.content: Confirm the order and thank the customer.

task_messages.content: End the call politely: "No problem at all, {customer_name}. When would be a better time for me to call you back?" Wait for their response, confirm the callback time, thank them, and end the call.

role_messages.content: Be understanding and flexible. Ask for a convenient callback time, confirm it, then politely end the call.

task_messages.content: Inform the customer: "Of course! Let me connect you to one of our specialists. Please hold on."

role_messages.content: Inform the customer that you are transferring them to a live agent.
